findings.scenario: Create proposal setSubmission({kind:'working'}) re-renders only the child. AgentStudioPanel.teammatesBusy stays false until the child's useEffect (after paint) calls onBusyChange(true). In that window the Working live region is on screen while Teammates/Site advice remain enabled. A Site advice click hides the in-flight status; the later busy=true then disables both mode pills so the user cannot return until the request finishes. Hidden aria-live also drops the working/result announcement. Static AgentStudioPanelContent tests pass teammatesBusy already true and never drive this wiring.
findings.remediation: Set onBusyChange(true) synchronously in createProposal in the same event as setSubmission(working), and onBusyChange(false) when committing a non-working state and on unmount. Better: lift `submission.kind==='working'` into AgentStudioPanel so mode disabled and Working UI commit together. Do not mirror busy only through useEffect after paint.

findings.line: it('locks every assignment control and announces an in-flight proposal')
findings.scenario: The working snapshot asserts eight disabled radios, a disabled textarea, and a disabled data-class select, but never reads the submit control. Product currently uses canSubmit=!isWorking so the button is disabled, yet the named working-disabled vs idle/error/result-editable oracle would still pass if Create proposal stayed enabled during working (double-submit / unlock path). Idle/error/result helpers check submit enabled; working has no inverse.
findings.remediation: In the working case assert the submit button is disabled and its label is Creating…; keep expectAssignmentControlsEnabled for idle/error/result so all four states pin radios, textarea, select, and submit together.

audit.proof_assessment: Focused vitest oracles do close auth-before-body (json/text unread), empty/unknown grants, envelope/task/hash/cost/lane binding, 1 Working vs 7 Idle markup, presentational mode disabled when teammatesBusy is pre-set, stale generation/run/assignment commit predicates, and token/44px CSS. They are almost all renderToStaticMarkup or helper-unit checks: they never click Create proposal through AgentStudioPanel, so they cannot witness parent mode lock lagging child Working, and the working-control test never inspects submit. Treat that as incomplete proof of the named in-flight lock and working-disabled ACs, not as closure.
residual_risks: No separate browser fetch timeout/AbortSignal (allowed residual unless an AC requires it).
A hung POST leaves Working plus mode pills disabled until run change/unmount; stale completions are dropped, not cancelled.
Proof still notes E2E/axe on the former assistant label and a partial full-suite timeout; those are outside this slice.
